sloka: ज्ञाननिष्ठाः कर्मनिष्ठाः योगनिष्ठास्तथापरे ।सीताशपथवीक्षार्थं सर्व एव समागताः ।। ७.९६.९ ॥
transliteration: jñānaniṣṭhāḥ karmaniṣṭhāḥ yoganiṣṭhāstathāpare ।sītāśapathavīkṣārthaṁ sarva eva samāgatāḥ ।। 7.96.9 ॥

translations.english: All these, including those devoted to knowledge, action, and yoga, had assembled there to witness Sita's oath.
